job.title: Chemical Process Engineer
job.description:
A growing industrial processing business based in East Arm, Darwin, is seeking a practical, hands-on Chemical or Process Engineer to join its operations team.
The business specialises in recovering and regenerating industrial process liquids and chemicals, including glycols and amines, as well as treating industrial wastewater and converting waste streams into reusable products.

About the Role

Reporting to the Production Manager, you will take ownership of day-to-day process performance across the facility.
This is a field-based role where you'll work alongside operators and maintenance teams, troubleshoot process issues, improve plant performance and contribute to upgrades and projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and optimise plant performance, recovery rates and product quality.
  • Troubleshoot process and equipment issues and implement improvements.
  • Work with SCADA, instrumentation and process control systems.
  • Prepare, update and field-verify PFDs, P&IDs and engineering drawings.
  • Develop process designs, calculations and specifications for plant upgrades.
  • Assist with commissioning, shutdowns, HAZOPs and risk assessments.
  • Support maintenance planning, contractors and plant improvement projects.
  • Maintain engineering documentation, SOPs and safety compliance.


To be successful, you will have:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering or similar.
  • At least 2 years' experience in an operating process plant.
  • Experience with AutoCAD, Plant 3D or similar P&ID software.
  • Understanding of SCADA, instrumentation and process control.
  • Strong troubleshooting and practical problem-solving skills.
  • A hands-on approach and commitment to workplace safety.
  • A current driver's licence and willingness to relocate to Darwin.

Highly regarded: Experience in LNG, oil and gas, glycol/amine systems, distillation, chemical recovery, wastewater treatment or commissioning.
What's on Offer?

  • Hands-on engineering with direct involvement in plant operations.
  • Exposure to process engineering, commissioning and project work.
  • Opportunity to influence plant performance and future development.
  • Relocation assistance for you and your family.
  • The lifestyle benefits of living and working in Darwin.

Ready for your next engineering challenge?
If you're a practical Chemical or Process Engineer who enjoys being on the plant floor and seeing projects through from concept to operation, apply now.
